policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.
policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python main.py --scenario=Offline --accuracy --gpu` as in the README's "Running the Benchmark" section, on the fine-tuned GPT-J-6B checkpoint in MODEL_DIR at the fp32 precision and beam size 4 of the README's reference ROUGE scores, over the 13,368-sample CNN/DailyMail validation set in DATASET_FILE, then evaluation.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.pytorch device:: the device the model's parameters are on
